itt.description: Intention-to-treat primary analysis (per ONTARGET reference-trial description in PLoS Med 2024 emulation paper); 3-week single-blind run-in before randomization

Cross-check from PMC4802446 (all 3 arms, 3-month landmark n=19,909): female 37.6%, diabetes 36.1%, HTN 93.7%, CHF 57.4%, prior stroke/TIA 28.1% -- consistent. prior_mi_pct (11.4%) is from PMC4802446 (all arms, landmark cohort). ckd_pct = CrCl <50 mL/min (~19% per WJC; 18.8% <=50 in PMC4802446). Median CrCl ~71 mL/min (not eGFR). Mean CHADS2 2.8.

part_A: PARADIGM-HF NEJM, COMET/ELITE II/LIFE Lancet pages returned 403; values for PARADIGM-HF come from the EJHF baseline paper + a PMC secondary analysis; COMET mostly from abstract + secondary summaries; ELITE II only abstract-level.
COMET female %, SBP, HR, AF are from secondary summaries (ACC, substack), not the Lancet Table 1.
TRANSFORM-HF age is a median; LVEF only categorical; hypertension/prior MI/stroke/smoking/creatinine not found in Table 1.
PARADIGM-HF eGFR/creatinine/CKD derived by n-weighting subgroups of PMC7754973 (n=8399, i.e. 43 fewer than randomised).
part_B: NEJM and JAMA sites returned HTTP 403, so primary Table 1s were reconstructed from ClinicalTrials.gov results plus open-access secondary analyses (PMC) whose Table 1 partitions the full randomized cohort.
PLATO/ARISTOTLE/ROCKET AF/RE-LY age_mean from CT.gov means; the NEJM papers report medians.
ROCKET AF continuous variables are medians.
RE-LY comorbidities are all-3-arm pooled values from a secondary reproduction (BMJ 2011 PMC3204867), not arm-restricted.
ALLHAT prior MI and stroke only reported combined (23.4%).
part_C: NEJM, Lancet, JAMA and AHA full texts returned HTTP 403; values came from PubMed abstracts (E-utilities), ClinicalTrials.gov posted results, PMC secondary papers, an ESH-hosted Lancet PDF (VALUE), ESC slides (EMPEROR-Preserved), and RxFiles/Wiki Journal Club (secondary; flagged).
ASCOT-BPLA Table 1 values are from a secondary summary (RxFiles) and rounded; treat as approximate.

ONTARGET HTN (69%), prior MI (48%) and heart rate (68) are from Wiki Journal Club (secondary, ramipril arm, rounded). Other ONTARGET fields are from the 3-arm cohort (N=25,620), not strictly tel+ram only.
ONTARGET: NEJM abstract calls the effect a 'relative risk' 1.01 (0.94-1.09); it is widely quoted as HR.
EMPA-REG: primary CI is 95.02%, analysis is modified ITT (treated set). Some Table 1 values come from the 7034-patient preliminary treated set.
DCP: prior MI 3.6% (EHR-derived) is low; current smoker 21.9% of all randomized vs 23.4% in JAHA table (denominator difference).
VALUE baseline diabetes is not in the main-paper Table 1; ~31% is only a back-calculation.
EMPEROR-Preserved heart rate and BMI are n-weighted from SBP subgroups; not reported directly.
part_D: PubMed web pages, NCBI Bookshelf and nejm.org/ahajournals returned CAPTCHA/403; abstracts were retrieved via NCBI E-utilities efetch instead (same text as PubMed).
EAST-AFNET 4 Table 1 values are derived from a secondary (prespecified) analysis pooling diabetes strata (n=2784/2789), not from NEJM Table 1. HR CI is 96% (not 95%).

CARES Table 1 largely from Wiki Journal Club (secondary); treat as unverified. Primary HR CI is a ONE-SIDED 98.5% upper bound 1.23; no lower bound in abstract. Commonly quoted signal is CV death HR 1.34, not the primary.

ENGAGE: CI level is 97.5% for stroke/SE. mITT on-treatment HR 0.79 (0.63-0.99) vs ITT HR 0.87 (0.73-1.04, P=0.08) -- ITT not significant. Table 1 values are warfarin-arm (secondary transcription) with pooled cross-check.
CAROLINA CI level is 95.47% (alpha adjusted for interim), not 95%.
INVEST result reported as 'relative risk' 0.98 (0.90-1.06) in abstract; Table 1 via WebFetch model summary of JAMA full text -- spot-check recommended.
CABANA age and BMI are medians; ITT HR 0.86 (0.65-1.15) is non-significant; per-protocol/treatment-received results were not retrieved here and should not be confused with the ITT primary.
general: Most NEJM/Lancet/JAMA pages returned 403; values drawn from PubMed abstracts (E-utilities), ClinicalTrials.gov results, PMC secondary/baseline papers, and in some cases secondary summaries (Wiki Journal Club, RxFiles, ACC) -- see per-trial value_notes. Values from secondary summaries should be treated as unverified.
